b: Home / Search Forum Recap / Daily Search Forum Recap: November 27, 2026
Here is a recap of what happened in the search forums today, through the eyes of the Search Engine Roundtable and other search forums on the web.

Bing is blending ads into organic results in its AI Mode results. Copilot shows ads in its responses as well. Google has a bug with reviews now showing in the local pack. Google Ads has a search ads insights tool. Google Merchant Center may be rolling out the Ads opportunities feature. Google AI Mode has follow up questions on image searches. Google AI Mode lets you upload multiple images for a response. ChatGPT Ads announced a bunch of new ad updates. I posted the weekly SEO video recap. I posted some old images of Ask Jeeves at the Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade.

Search News Buzz Video Recap: Google November Core Update, December Core Preannounced, Search Ranking Hub, Google StarSearch & Search Ad News
This week, we covered the completion of the Google November 2026 core update and then were hit by a surprise, preannounced Google December 2026 core update; no, it is not live yet. Google launched a new search ranking hub....

Bing AI Mode Ads Blending More With Organic Results
Microsoft Advertising is making it harder to distinguish ads in Bing AI Mode results from organic results. Microsoft has a very long history of making it hard to understand what is an advertisement versus what is an organic listing in its search results, so you can expect them to continue to do this within AI Mode and Copilot Search.

Google Local Pack No Reviews Bug
Google is not showing reviews in the local pack for some business listings that do indeed have reviews. Google shows "No reviews" with no stars in the local pack for these businesses, but when you click on the listing, Google does show that these businesses have reviews.

Google AI Mode Image Results Ask A Follow Up Button
Google AI Mode now lets you Ask a follow up question on image results, after you click on the image and see the image on the right side image pane. I see two variations of this, including "Ask a follow-up" that has an animated Google ring around the button and a "Ask about this image" button.

Google AI Mode Gains Multiple Image Uploads
Google AI Mode now lets you snap multiple photos or upload multiple images for one query. Similar to what we saw with the image collections AI Mode feature, you can now attach up to 10 images to an AI Mode query and Google will respond taking into consideration all the images.

Google Ads Search Insights Tool
Google Ads has a search ads insights tool, also known as search insights, that shows you emerging and declining trends related to your topic or category. I don't think this is super new, as I found some Google Ads documents and blog posts on it recently but I have never covered it before.

Google Merchant Center Ads Opportunities With New Features?
Google Merchant Center may be rolling out the Ads opportunities feature in Google Merchant Center for Agencies, which we covered twice already. Now, some advertisers are seeing the "new" label on the "Ads opportunities" section in the console.

Copilot Has Ads From Microsoft Advertising
Microsoft is showing ads in Copilot responses to some users powered by Microsoft Advertising. I don't think this is new, I see some examples of this from earlier this year, but this is the first time I am covering it.

ChatGPT Ads New Call-To-Actions, Business Agents Beyond US, More Audience Metrics & More
OpenAI just sent out a product update on ChatGPT Ads announcing that Business Agents expand outside the U.S., new learn more call-to-action added to single image ads, more audience metrics in Ads Manager and the Ads API, ability to hide product feed sale prices when a promotion ends and new policy center details in Ads Manager.

Ask Jeeves At Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade (Old Photos)
On Thanksgiving day we normally have the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City but today, for the first time, it was postponed due to weather. And Danny Sullivan reminded me that Ask Jeeves, which was an early search engine and lasted nearly 30 years, that Ask Jeeves was at the parade three times.
